howItMakesMoney.text: Members pay an annual fee of $65 in the U.S., which provides recurring revenue.
howItMakesMoney.quote: Our annual fee for memberships is $65 in the U.S., varies in other countries and includes a free household card.

marketPosition.text: Costco notes that Walmart, Target, Kroger and Amazon are its major competitors in the United States.
marketPosition.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.

industryTrends.text: Costco says online and mobile retailing lets customers compare prices more easily, increasing competition.
industryTrends.quote: The evolution of retailing in online and mobile channels has improved the ability of customers to comparison shop, which has enhanced competition.

demandDrivers.text: Comparable sales grow when members shop more often and spend more per visit.
demandDrivers.quote: Comparable sales growth is achieved through increasing shopping frequency from new and existing members and the amount they spend on each visit (average ticket).

source.label: 10-K filed October 7, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

biggestRisks.text: Costco says it relies heavily on the performance of its U.S. and Canadian operations.
biggestRisks.quote: We are highly dependent on the financial performance of our U.S. and Canadian operations.

biggestRisks.text: Growth depends on acquiring and building new warehouse sites, which can be difficult.
biggestRisks.quote: Our growth is dependent, in part, on our ability to acquire property and build or lease new warehouses and depots.

biggestRisks.text: Disruptions in distribution or manufacturing could hurt sales and member satisfaction.
biggestRisks.quote: Disruptions in merchandise distribution or processing, packaging, manufacturing, and other facilities could adversely affect sales and member satisfaction.

dropped.text: Costco runs membership warehouses in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand.
dropped.quote: We operate membership warehouses in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand.

dropped.text: Costco also runs e‑commerce sites for members in several countries.
dropped.quote: We operate e‑commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the U.K., Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, and China.

dropped.text: The company sells low‑priced, limited‑selection merchandise to generate high sales volume and fast inventory turnover.
dropped.quote: We offer low prices on a limited selection of products to generate high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover.

dropped.text: Costco says it can operate profitably with much lower gross margins than most retailers.
dropped.quote: We operate profitably at significantly lower gross margins than most other retailers.

dropped.text: Costco expects to spend about $7.5 billion on capital projects in fiscal 2027.
dropped.quote: We intend to spend approximately $7,500 during fiscal 2027.

dropped.text: The company plans to open up to 33 new warehouses, including five relocations, in 2027.
